title: Run for charity – TCS London Marathon
claims: Runners apply for a guaranteed charity place directly through a listed charity's own website; each charity manages its own team, benefits and fundraising requirements.
Marie Curie is the 2026 Charity of the Year; runners who already hold a ballot place can still join a listed charity team.
Charity runners use a personalised Enthuse fundraising page; many charities offer perks such as a branded running vest and other Marathon Day benefits.
